answer.text: Welcome! You are a visitor, aren't you? You haven't tried the local soup, have you? Both of us are interested in old traditions, and neither of us likes noisy places. I recommend the soup. What do you enjoy most? Do you like spicy food?
accepted: Welcome! You are a visitor, aren't you? You haven't tried the local soup, have you? Both of us are interested in old traditions, and neither of us likes noisy places. I recommend the soup. What do you enjoy most? Do you like spicy food?

You are new here, aren't you? You haven't tried the local soup, have you? We are both interested in local traditions, and neither of us likes noisy places. What do you like most? Do you enjoy spicy food?

feedback.es: Una buena charla junta tags para confirmar datos, both of us o neither of us para comparar y preguntas de seguimiento para seguir hablando.

origin.text: Hablas con un visitante. Confirma con un tag que es visitante y otro que no ha probado la sopa. Di que a los dos os interesan las tradiciones y que a ninguno le gustan los lugares ruidosos. Recomienda la sopa y haz dos preguntas: qué le gusta más y si le gusta la comida picante.

prompt.es: Escucha y elige qué quieren hacer.

choices.text: They want to watch the parade.
They do not want to go.

feedback.es: Both of us want to see the parade: a los dos les gustaría ver el desfile.

origin.audio: Neither of us has a costume, but both of us want to see the parade.

feedback.es: Love lleva do, así que la respuesta es So do I, y la pregunta continúa la charla.
